story_text:
## Ships in Nov Expected by Christmas
[画像: Ships in Nov Expected by Christmas]
You know your carry, spin, launch angle, and club path. But numbers only tell you what happened—not why.
What caused the miss? Was it your swing? What should you change next?
Without that connection, practice becomes a cycle of checking numbers, making adjustments, and wondering whether you’re even working on the right thing.
## See the Swing Behind the Shot
[画像: See the Swing Behind the Shot]
Shot numbers tell only part of the story. NeoPace G10 Pro connects your body movement, club delivery, and ball flight to help you understand what’s really behind every shot.
Explore your swing in 3D Replay™ to see how you moved and how it shaped the shot. Then turn to TrainerIQ™ to identify potential issues and get clear on what to work on next.
See what happened. Understand why. Know what to work on next.
## Share & Earn 10% Cash Back
## NeoPace in the Spotlight
[画像: NeoPace in the Spotlight]
## Tested by Golfers Who Know the Game
[画像: Tested by Golfers Who Know the Game]
120 real shots. Multiple launch monitors. One real-world test. See how NeoPace performs alongside TM4 and R50, with a a golf professional putting the devices through their paces indoors and on the range.
## Indoor Test — 120 Shots in One Continuous Take
## Outdoor Test — 120 Shots in One Continuous Take
## What Makes NeoPace G10 Pro Truly Unique?
[画像: What Makes NeoPace G10 Pro Truly Unique?]
Triple-Cam + 24GHz Doppler Radar System combines a 120 fps Player View with a 480 fps Impact View to capture your full swing, impact, and ball flight—delivering precise, reliable shot data.
Turn every swing into an interactive 3D Replay. Explore it in 360°, jump to 7 key moments, and see how your body, club, and ball come together—so you can understand not just what happened, but why.
NeoPace goes beyond simply showing how your body moved. High-precision motion tracking reconstructs the connection between Body → Club → Ball, helping you see how your movement shapes the shot.
See what happened to every shot with precise data across ball speed, launch, spin, carry, club speed, face angle, and more.
Understand what happened in your swing with detailed insights into posture, rotation, balance, joint movement, and key body positions.
TrainerIQ™ transforms your body movement, club delivery, and ball flight data into clear visual insights, progress trends, and text-based answers — helping you understand what happened, why it may have happened, and what to look at next.
Go beyond the result. TrainerIQ™ connects your body movement, club delivery, and ball flight to help show what may have led to each miss.
Know exactly what to work on next. TrainerIQ™ turns identified swing issues into clear recommendations, practice goals, and focused drills—so you spend less time guessing and more time working on what matters.
See key swing insights directly in the app, with simple explanations that connect your data to the shot you just hit.
TrainerIQ™ helps golfers at different levels focus on the metrics that matter most — from making cleaner contact, to building more speed, to improving clubface control.
Ask anything about your swing and get personalized answers powered by NeoPace Proprietary AI.
## Built for the Way You Practice
[画像: Built for the Way You Practice]
Set up just 1.6–2.1 m (5.2–6.9 ft) from the ball—easy to fit into your home, garage, or range setup.
Practice seamlessly across garage, home, and driving range setups—with one launch monitor built to go wherever your game takes you.
Connect NeoPace with GSPro, Creative Golf, E6 and more third-party simulator platforms—with no unlock fee or subscription required for connectivity. More ways to practice, play, and compete, without paying extra just to connect.
## Powerful by Default. Go Further with Premium AI
[画像: Powerful by Default.  Go Further with Premium AI]
Core features are included with every NeoPace G10 Pro—no subscription required. Get essential AI analysis included, or upgrade to Premium AI for deeper insights, personalized guidance, and more AI-analyzed shots.
## FREE | Measure. Replay. Understand.
Everything you need to measure your shots, replay your swing, and understand your movement—included with G10 Pro, no subscription required.
## PREMIUM AI | Ask. Practice. Improve.
Go further with personalized AI guidance, tailored drills, progress insights, and up to 1,000 AI-analyzed shots per month.
## Free vs. Premium AI
[画像: Free vs. Premium AI]
See what’s included with G10 Pro—and what you unlock with Premium AI.
## Real Golfers Real Feedback
[画像: Real Golfers Real Feedback]

[画像: Free Shipping & Tax Policy]
Enjoy free shipping on every NeoPace G10 Pro order to the U.S., Canada, the UK, Australia, New Zealand, EU countries (excluding Cyprus and Malta), Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macao — so there’s no extra shipping cost to worry about when you back us.

faq.q: Product | Is putting supported in the built-in range, third-party simulator mode or on the course?
faq.a: G10 Pro is expected to support putting by the time the first units are delivered in December 2026. We’ll share details about availability in the built-in range, third-party simulators and on-course use once they are confirmed.

faq.q: Product | Which third-party simulators will G10 Pro support, and when will they be available?
faq.a:
G10 Pro is compatible with GSPro, Creative Golf, and E6. No additional NeoPace unlock fee or subscription is required to connect to these platforms. Any GSPro, Creative Golf, or E6 software license or subscription must be purchased separately from the respective provider.

Compatibility will be available by the time crowdfunding units ship. Availability on the campaign launch day is still to be confirmed.

faq.q: Payment｜How do I back NeoPace on Kickstarter?
faq.a:
Sign in to Kickstarter and open the official NeoPace campaign page. Click “Back this project,” choose your preferred Reward and shipping destination, review your pledge and payment details, and confirm your pledge.
Limited Early Bird Rewards are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

faq.q: Order | Who qualifies for the free Lifetime Premium AI upgrade?
faq.a: Once our Kickstarter campaign reaches 600 backers, all backers of a 15-month Premium AI package will receive a free upgrade to Lifetime Premium AI. This includes existing and new backers of the single-device, Duo, and 10-Pack 15-month packages. Packages with only 3 months of Premium AI do not qualify unless you switch to a 15-month package before the campaign ends. This offer is exclusive to this Kickstarter campaign.

faq.q: Order | Do I need to do anything to receive the upgrade?
faq.a:
If you’ve already backed a 15-month Premium AI package, no action or separate application is needed—keep your current pledge, and your free Lifetime upgrade will unlock when we reach 600 backers.
If you’ve backed a 3-month package, open the NeoPace campaign on the Kickstarter website and click “Manage your pledge” → “Change your pledge.” Select the matching 15-month reward, review the updated total, and confirm before the campaign ends. The package price difference applies; simply increasing you…

faq.q: Payment | How does Kickstarter collect payment for my pledge?
faq.a:
If the NeoPace campaign reaches its funding goal, Kickstarter will attempt to charge the payment method you provided when the campaign ends. You will not be charged when you first make your pledge.

Once your payment has been successfully collected, Kickstarter will send you a confirmation email with your pledge details and Reward selection. You can also review this information under Backed Projects in your Kickstarter account.

If your payment fails, Kickstarter will:

- Send you email reminder…

faq.q: Deposit Holders | How do I back NeoPace and receive up to $100 Cashback?
faq.a:
Sign in to Kickstarter, open the official NeoPace campaign, select “Back this project,” choose your Reward and shipping destination, and confirm your pledge.

The email used for your Deposit will serve as proof of eligibility for the Cashback, so no additional application is required. Please make sure you use the same email address for your Kickstarter pledge. Your Deposit does not automatically create a pledge and will not be deducted at checkout.

After the campaign ends and Kickstarter succes…

faq.q: Deposit Holders | What if my deposit email is different from my Kickstarter email?
faq.a: If the email used for your Deposit is different from the email on your Kickstarter account, please send us a private message through Kickstarter after you pledge. Include the email address used for your Deposit on the official NeoPace website and a screenshot of your Kickstarter order confirmation. After the campaign ends, we will manually verify and match your reservation to your Kickstarter pledge.

faq.q: Order | What are the Kickstarter reward prices?
faq.a:
Kickstarter Reward prices are as follows:

G10 Pro with 3-Month Premium AI: $899
G10 Pro with 15-Month Premium AI: $999
Two G10 Pro units with 3-Month Premium AI per device: $1,699
Two G10 Pro units with 15-Month Premium AI per device: $1,899
Ten G10 Pro units with 3-Month Premium AI per device: $8,299
Ten G10 Pro units with 15-Month Premium AI per device: $9,299

If you have placed a $30 Deposit, please see Q3 for details on how your cashback applies.

faq.q: Product | Do I need a subscription to use G10 Pro?
faq.a: No. Core features remain available without a subscription, including ball and club data, replay tools and on-device session history. The Free plan also includes a shared allowance of five AI-analyzed shots per month for 3D Swing Analysis and TrainerIQ Analysis. Premium is optional for higher analysis usage and additional AI services.

faq.q: Product | How much is Premium, and what does it include?
faq.a: NeoPace Premium Individual is $19.99 per month or $199.99 per year. It supports one AI Analysis Profile and includes up to 1,000 AI-analyzed shots per month, along with Ask TrainerIQ, Performance Insights, Personalized Drills, Practice Goals, and Cloud Storage. Each G10 Pro backed on Kickstarter includes 3 Months of Premium AI at no additional cost, exclusively for Kickstarter backers.

faq.q: Product | How are the monthly AI analysis limits counted?
faq.a:
3D Swing Analysis and TrainerIQ Analysis share one monthly allowance, which resets on your subscription renewal date. Each shot counts once, even if you use both analysis features.

Free includes 5 AI-analyzed shots per month. Premium Individual includes up to 1,000 AI-analyzed shots per month.

faq.q: Product | How much Premium access comes with my reward?
faq.a:
Each Kickstarter Reward includes the Premium AI period listed in its Reward description. Depending on the Reward you choose, this is either 3 months or 15 months of Premium AI per device.

This is a fixed-term Reward benefit and does not renew automatically. After the included period ends, you can continue using Free features or choose to purchase a Premium Subscription.

faq.q: Product | Does Premium renew automatically, and how can I cancel?
faq.a:
Premium Access included with your Crowdfunding Reward is a fixed-term benefit. It does not renew automatically, and no cancellation is required.

If you later purchase a Premium Subscription, it will renew automatically until you cancel it. You can cancel at any time through your account.

faq.q: Shipping & Taxes | When will G10 Pro ship?
faq.a: Shipping is planned to begin in November 2026. We expect most backers to receive their G10 Pro before Christmas 2026, although deliveries to some countries may be delayed by local delivery services or customs clearance.
